title: Prime Minister shares an article by Sri Mata Amritanandamayi Ji highlighting PM Modi's vision of a prosperous Bharat while preserving cultural heritage
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by Sri Mata Amritanandamayi Ji. In the article, Sri Mata Amritanandamayi Ji reflects on the Prime Minister’s vision of a prosperous Bharat while preserving its cultural heritage. It highlights his focus on social reform, cleanliness, women's empowerment, youth and the environment, along with efforts in education, health and sanitation. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X: “Sri Mata Amritanandamayi Ji reflects on PM @narendramodi's vision of a prosperous Bharat while preserving its cultural heritage. She highlights his focus on social reform, cleanliness, women's empowerment, youth and the environment, along with efforts in education, health and sanitation. Do read!”
